key_insight: A fully differentiable graph-based implicit solver treats PDE systems as constraints, supporting stable forward simulation and gradient-based inverse modeling on unstructured grids.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce simulation costs and support parameter or source estimation in engineering applications such as geophysics.
method: Represent discretized PDE solutions on graphs derived from unstructured grids.
Incorporate equation-system constraints into a fully differentiable implicit solver.
Learn graph coarsening to accelerate forward modeling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on linear and nonlinear evolutionary and static PDEs, coefficient estimation, right-hand-side estimation, and learnable graph coarsening, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical scalability and accuracy under learned coarsening require validation; the abstract does not quantify either.
paper_title: Automatic Differentiation with Constraints in Forward and Inverse Problems
